jobs.occupation: Senior data engineer for US Product Team
jobs.description:
Vi vil løbende vurdere ansøgninger, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Om stillingen

Som Senior Data Engineer i vores US Product Team bliver du en nøglefigur i udviklingen af vores datainfrastruktur og -løsninger. Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med vores produkt- og trading-team for at sikre, at vi har de rette data og værktøjer til at drive vores forretningsudvikling fremad.

Dine opgaver

• Design, udvikling og vedligeholdelse af robuste data pipelines og arkitekturer.

• Samarbejde med stakeholders for at forstå forretningskrav og oversætte dem til tekniske løsninger.

• Optimering af eksisterende dataprocesser for at øge effektivitet og pålidelighed.

• Sikring af datakvalitet og -integritet på tværs af vores systemer.

• Mentoring og sparring med mindre erfarne kolleger i teamet.

Om dig

• Du har en relevant uddannelse inden for datalogi, softwareudvikling eller lignende.

• Du har flere års erfaring med data engineering, gerne med fokus på store datamængder og cloud-løsninger.

• Du er fortrolig med moderne data-teknologier som f.eks. Python, SQL, Apache Spark, Kafka eller lignende.

• Du har erfaring med cloud-platforme som AWS, Azure eller GCP.

• Du er en selvstændig problemløser, der trives i et dynamisk og tværfagligt miljø.

• Du har gode kommunikative evner på både dansk og engelsk.

Vi tilbyder

• Et spændende og udfordrende job i en international virksomhed med højt til loftet.

• Mulighed for at påvirke og forme vores data-strategi og -arkitektur.

• Et godt kollegialt miljø med fokus på faglig udvikling og personlig vækst.

• Konkurrencedygtige løn- og ansættelsesvilkår.

Sådan søger du

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Steen Lykke Jeppesen, Senior manager, Head of Short-Term Trading Technology, på telefon [nummer mangler i kilde].

Send din ansøgning og dit CV via linket nedenfor. Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Apply for job

Om Danske Commodities

Danske Commodities er en førende aktør inden for handel og rådgivning i energimarkedet. Vi har kontorer i flere lande og en stærk tilstedeværelse i Norden, Europa og USA. Vores mål er at levere innovative løsninger og værdi til vores kunder og aktionærer.

**Join Dalux and design products that transform the construction industry

**As a Product Designer at Dalux, you'll join a team of 12 designers creating intuitive solutions for one of the world's largest, and least digitalised industries.

You'll be part of cross-functional product teams, collaborating with Product Management and Engineering throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery to delivery. Through user research, prototyping, and iterative design, you'll turn complex workflows into intuitive experiences used by construction professionals around the world.

Over the past two years, we've invested significantly in growing our design practice. We've built a strong design community, but we're still evolving. This means you'll have the opportunity to influence not only the products we build, but also how design is embedded across our organisation.

**In this role, you will

**

• Collaborate with Product Managers and developers to discover opportunities and shape product direction

• Conduct user research, interviews, and usability testing to understand user needs and validate ideas

• Design user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished user interfaces using Figma and AI tools throughout the design process

• Use Dalux's design system to create consistent experiences across our products and contribute to its continued evolution

• Work closely with developers to bring your designs to life and continuously improve the user experience

**Your Background

**We're looking for someone who enjoys turning complex problems into simple, intuitive user experiences. Ideally, you have:

• At least 3 years of experience designing complex software products, preferably within SaaS

• A relevant university degree (Bachelor's or Master’s level)

• Experience with user research and end-to-end product design

• Confidence collaborating closely with Product Managers and developers in cross-functional teams

• A curious, analytical, and detail-oriented mindset with the ability to quickly understand technical systems, industry-specific workflows, and new technologies such as AI

• Fluency in English and proficiency in at least one of the following languages: Danish, German, French, Spanish, or Italian

**What To Expect As a Daluxian

**At Dalux, you'll join an international product organisation where collaboration, trust, and continuous learning are part of everyday work. We offer:

• A central Copenhagen office with a healthy work-life balance, no overtime culture, and no dress code

• Flat hierarchies, short decision-making paths, and the freedom to influence both products and ways of working

• A collaborative design team that values knowledge sharing, feedback, and professional development

• An active social environment with monthly events and employee clubs

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, coffee, fruit, and free parking

**Next Steps

**If you're excited about designing products that solve real-world problems and help shape the future of construction technology, we'd love to hear from you. Submit your CV, application, and portfolio today. If you have any questions about the role, please don't hesitate to contact Line Hassenkam Klinge.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux develops software that digitises the construction industry. Today, we're more than 900 colleagues across 30+ countries, while all product development takes place at our headquarters in Copenhagen.

Using technologies such as cloud computing, 3D visualisation, computer vision, drones, and AI, we create software that supports the entire lifecycle of a building, from design and construction to operation and maintenance, helping our customers save time, reduce waste, and build smarter.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

**Job Description Summary

**As a Service Account Leader at GE HealthCare, you will play a key role in growing our service business across Denmark. By building trusted customer relationships and delivering innovative lifecycle solutions, you will help healthcare providers maximize equipment uptime, optimize operational performance, and deliver exceptional patient care.

Working closely with local sales and service teams, you will identify new business opportunities, develop strategic service offerings, and drive sustainable growth across our Imaging, Ultrasound, and Patient Care Solutions portfolio. The role combines commercial leadership, customer engagement, and cross-functional collaboration in a dynamic international environment.

**Responsibilities

****Job Description

**

• Sell point-of-sale service contracts and solutions while protecting margin by communicating value and maintaining pricing discipline.

• Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of GE HealthCare’s service solutions and relevant competitive offerings.

• Develop account penetration strategies for key target accounts and competitive accounts. Share market intelligence, field concerns, emerging issues, and customer requirements with the wider business.

• Lead customer negotiations and close deals by engaging key buying stakeholders, including technical and biomedical personnel, department heads, and C-suite executives.

• Achieve annual and quarterly revenue targets by maintaining accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts, prioritizing selling time effectively, increasing sales volume, deepening account penetration, and ensuring comprehensive territory coverage.

• Maintain strong after-sales relationships, develop long-term customer partnerships, and identify opportunities that address both immediate and evolving customer needs.

**Qualifications/Requirements

**

• At least one of the following core experiences:

• Consultative sales or marketing experience, including strategic selling and negotiation in a complex sales environment involving multiple decision-makers and influencers.

• Healthcare service experience, preferably in Diagnostic Imaging, Ultrasound, or Patient Care Solutions.

• Experience in one or more customer-facing roles.

• Excellent written and spoken Danish and English language skills.

• Willingness to travel within the assigned geographic region.

**Desired Skills

**

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

• Previous Healthcare sales experience.

• Robust interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability to work independently as well as with a team.

• Strong written and verbal communication and clear thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex issues into simple messages.

• Solid process orientation, demonstrated resource management and allocation experience, and the ability to perform multiple tasks simultaneously.

• Ability to energize, develop, and build rapport at all levels within an organization.

• Experience interfacing with both internal team members and external customers as a part of a solution-based sales process.

**Inclusion and Diversity

**GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

**Behaviours

**We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

**Total Rewards

**Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

******Additional Information

******Relocation Assistance Provided: No

Join the fastest growing and most dedicated SuccessFactors team in the Nordics

We are looking for a Bid Manager to join our Copenhagen office. This is a role that sits at the heart of our commercial process, supporting the commercial team as they lead sales opportunities, and is well suited for someone who enjoys structure, thrives under deadlines, and wants to make our bid management function as sharp as possible.

At Gavdi, we believe HR technology should make work life better, not more complicated. As a trusted SAP SuccessFactors partner, we help organisations across Europe transform how they manage their people.

This role suits someone how is ready to own bid management independently and make sound judgement calls without needing much guidance. You will be the person others turn to when a bid needs to get done, and the one shaping how it gets done going forward. The role also leaves room to explore beyond the core bid work, picking up adjacent tasks and responsibilities as your interests and our needs evolve.

What you will do

Bid management (the core of the role)

• Support the bid process end to end, from qualification to submission, working closely with our Client Partners as they take the commercial lead on opportunities

• Own and continuously improve bid templates, boilerplate content and a reusable library of case studies and references

• Support the review and structuring of legal and contractual content in bids, flagging points that need legal or commercial sign-off

• Keep bid documentation organised, on brand and consistent in quality across opportunities

• Track bid status, deadlines and follow-ups so nothing falls through the cracks

• Identify inefficiencies in how bids get done and drive practical improvements to tools, templates and ways of working

• Provide presales support by pulling together relevant collateral, prior references and standard solution write-ups

_Compliance support (a smaller part of the role)

_

• Support the upkeep of Gavdi’s certifications, including ISAE 3000 and ISO/IEC 27001

• Help prepare documentation and evidence ahead of audits

• Build general compliance awareness

What we are looking for

• Some experience in bid management, proposal coordination, presales support or related commercial roles. HR technology sector or consulting experience is a plus

• Good commercial understanding, comfortable reading and organising bids, terms and basic risk considerations

• Organised and structured, with the ability to juggle multiple bids and keep them on track

• Strong written communication skills, able to turn input from different teams into a clear and coherent document

• A collaborative mindset and the confidence to build relationships and coordinate across the business without formal authority. Since you’ll be carrying this function on your own, your ability to connect with people across teams is what makes you effective, and it’s something you’ll get to build from the ground up.

• Comfortable working independently, making sound judgement on when to flag things up

• Eager to keep learning and to shape the role as it grows,

• Based in Copenhagen or the surrounding area

What we offer

• An informal workplace where you will learn from experienced colleagues from day one

• Real responsibility early on. We believe in giving people room to grow

• A visible role at the heart of the sales process, with genuine room to shape how bid management works

• A team culture built on knowledge sharing, collaboration and having each other’s backs

A Snapshot of Your Day

As a software developer in our turbine software team, you will play a key role in developing the embedded software that controls wind turbines. Your day will involve close collaboration with team members and stakeholders from around the world, working through the full software development lifecycle—from requirements clarification and implementation to testing and maintenance. You’ll contribute to innovative projects, participate in agile SCRUM teams, and help ensure our solutions are robust, secure, and high-performing. With a flexible work environment, you’ll have the opportunity to balance independent tasks with teamwork, both in the office and remotely.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Develop and maintain control software in C++ for Linux-based embedded systems, ensuring reliable operation of wind turbines.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions.

• Conduct comprehensive software testing, including unit, integration, and acceptance tests, employing strong CI/CD practices and AI-assisted programming.

• Refactor and enhance existing code to maintain fleet performance and participate in innovation initiatives such as code camps and ideation events.

• Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by following agile development principles within a SCRUM and SAFe environment.

What You Bring

• Academic degree in IT, Software, Electronics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, combined with 5+ years of experience in C/C++ software development.

• Proficiency in object-oriented programming, software testing, continuous integration, embedded control mechanisms, and middleware development for Linux-based x86 and ARM platforms, including Linux system hardening for cyber-security.

• A keen interest in control of mechanical areas such as aerodynamics, mechanics, hydraulics, and power electronics, with a passion for integrating hardware and software into safe, high-quality solutions.

• Experience working with real-time protocols (e.g., ProfiNet), version control systems (Git), task management tools (Jira), and agile development methodologies such as SCRUM and SAFe.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, combined with a structured and proactive approach, an ownership mindset, and a passion for delivering high-quality software solutions in the renewable energy sector.

About the Team

You’ll join a diverse and innovative team dedicated to advancing renewable energy through pioneering software solutions. We value collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning, working together in an agile environment to drive the success of our wind turbine projects. Our team thrives on mutual support, open communication, and a shared commitment to making a positive impact on the world.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Opportunities to work with a global team

• Medical benefits

• Remote/Flexible work

• Paid holidays and parental leave

• Employer-funded pension

• Subsidised lunch and more

Can you keep an overview in a busy operational environment, bring structure to your tasks and make the right priorities when plans change? Do you enjoy working with people, taking responsibility and finding solutions?

Blue Water Shipping is looking for a dedicated Port Agent to join our Cruise & Port Agency team in Greve. As a Port Agent, you will become part of our 24/7 duty setup, acting as the link between our customers, vessels, ports, authorities, suppliers and other stakeholders. Flexibility is important part of the position, and it requires working outside normal office hours in connection with vessel operations, including early mornings, evenings, nights and weekends.

**About The Role

**As part of the team, you will be involved in planning, coordinating and following vessel calls from the initial preparations until the vessel has departed again. The role combines office-based planning and administration with hands-on operational work at vessels and terminals. You will work with a broad variety of vessels, including cruise ships, cargo vessels and navy vessels calling at Danish ports. The role is primarily based in Greve, but occasional work in Copenhagen is required, as Copenhagen is a major part of the daily operation.

Following your training and as your experience develops, you will take responsibility for coordinating your own vessel calls and daily operations, always with experienced colleagues and managers available for support and sparring. You will act as the customer’s local representative and help ensure that each port call is handled safely, professionally and according to the agreed operational plan.

**Your primary responsibilities will include:

**

• Coordination and handling of vessel port calls

• Planning and coordination of daily port operations

• Daily communication with vessels, customers, ports, authorities and suppliers

• Attendance of vessels and operations at the pier when required

• Handling vessel clearances and relevant documentation

• Coordination of crew changes, transportation and other crew-related services

• Arranging services, supplies, spare parts and other vessel requirements

• Customer invoicing and administrative follow-up

• Handling changing operational requirements and finding solutions when plans change

• Supporting port calls in other Danish ports when required

**Who Are You

**Previous experience in ship agency, shipping or a similar operational role is an advantage, but not a requirement. We are also open to candidates with transferable experience from other service-oriented or operational environments. Most importantly, you are reliable, service-minded, proactive and motivated to learn.

We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership and follows tasks through

• Is proactive, solution-oriented and adaptable

• Remains calm and structured under pressure

• Communicates confidently and professionally with different stakeholders

• Works well both independently and as part of a team

• Enjoys a fast-paced, international environment

• Has an interest in shipping, port operations and the maritime industry

You should have strong written and spoken English skills, be comfortable with MS Office and new IT systems, hold a valid Category B driving licence, and be able to travel within Denmark and occasionally abroad.

**What We Offer

**At Blue Water Shipping, you will become part of an informal working environment with experienced colleagues and a strong focus on cooperation, responsibility and professional development.

You will have the opportunity to learn the port agency profession through hands-on experience and daily sparring with colleagues and managers.

We offer:

• A varied working day with responsibility and operational challenges

• Hands-on experience within the international shipping and cruise industries

• Training and continuous professional development

• The opportunity to gradually take responsibility for your own vessel calls and customers

• Close cooperation with experienced colleagues across Blue Water Shipping

• Exposure to international customers, vessels, ports and maritime professionals

• A strong community where cooperation, commitment and team spirit are important

**Contact

**If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Pernille Marcussen, Manager, Cruise & Port Agency, at +45 42124613 or pmar@bws.dk.

Apply as soon as possible, as we review and interview on an ongoing basis.

What we do – Together we create solutions

We are a proud family-owned company, founded in Denmark in 1972, and a global provider of all logistics services within modern supply chain management. Our value foundation is still thriving today, driven by a pronounced entrepreneurial spirit and sound business practices. Therefore, our employees are offered a strong professional environment with great freedom, ensuring our customers the best service. Blue Water Shipping is represented by more than 2,700 employees worldwide, combining a strong global network with local expertise, enabling us to offer complete and tailored solutions for any shipping need anywhere in the world.

Do you have experience working with HR systems and master data processes, and would you like to help shape JYSK’s future HCM platform? Are you motivated to play a central role in the implementation of our new HCM solution across JYSK countries? Then this could be your next opportunity at JYSK Head office in Aarhus.

As HCM System Specialist, you will join the agile Human Capital Management team and act as a subject matter expert within HR systems and processes. You will work closely with colleagues in Payroll, HR and IT across JYSK countries, helping to optimise existing solutions while supporting the implementation of new systems and processes. The role combines system expertise, stakeholder collaboration, testing, training and continuous improvement in an international environment.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, your attitude, commitment and willingness to learn are valued. You will become part of an experienced and supportive team where knowledge sharing, collaboration and development are part of everyday work. As we continue our digital transformation journey within HR, you will have the opportunity to influence solutions used across the organisation and contribute to projects with significant business impact.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A key role in one of the largest initiatives currently taking place in JYSK helping shape future HR processes and technology globally in JYSK

• The chance to contribute to the continued development and support of our HR systems across 30 JYSK countries impacting more than 38.000 employees in JYSK

• The opportunity to participate in and lead selected HCM projects

• Close collaboration with HR, Payroll and IT stakeholders across the business

• A workplace where responsibility and trust go hand in hand

• Professional and personal development opportunities in an international company

• An agile working environment focused on continuous improvement

• Strong teams, knowledge sharing and a supportive culture

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

In this role, you will be responsible for supporting and improving HCM processes and systems across the organisation. You will help ensure stable operations while contributing to future system developments, process design and overall requirement management. You will act as the link between business needs and technical solutions and play a key role in ensuring quality through testing, training and stakeholder collaboration.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Subject matter expert support on and optimisation of SAP HR and HR master data processes

• Drive and take part in the implementation of global HCM templates ensuring scalable and standardised solutions across countries

• Translating business requirements into functional specifications for IT teams

• Supporting implementation activities across countries

• Participating in and leading selected HCM projects and rollouts

• Planning, coordinating and executing testing activities for new HCM solutions

• Delivering user support, training sessions and knowledge-sharing activities

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for someone who enjoys combining system knowledge with collaboration and problem-solving. You are structured in your approach, comfortable working with multiple stakeholders and motivated by improving processes and solutions that create value across the business.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has 3-5 years of experience working with HCM systems, e.g. SAP SuccessFactors or SAP HR

• Holds a bachelor's degree within HR, Organisation, Business Administration or a related field, or has equivalent experience from Payroll or HR Support

• Has experience with system implementation, process development or digital transformation initiatives

• Has worked with system testing, user support and training activities

• Communicates clearly and can translate business needs into technical requirements

• Builds strong relationships with stakeholders across functions and countries

• Thrives in an agile environment and takes responsibility for delivering high-quality results

Do you want to have an influence on home furnishing trends across multiple countries? As Head of Range and Design at JYSK, you will define how our products look, feel and work together – from sleep and furniture to textiles and home décor.

You will own the vision and direction for JYSK’s overall product universe, establishing the design DNA that connects our products across categories. By translating our brand, trends, customer insights and commercial ambitions into a clear design direction and compelling collections, you will make it easier for customers to create an affordable Scandinavian home.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You will join an international retail company with high ambitions, short decision-making processes and a strong focus on results. Based at JYSK Head Office in Aarhus, Denmark, you will work closely with colleagues across the organisation to turn creative ideas into products that reach customers across countries.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A strategic leadership role with significant influence on JYSK’s design direction, product universe and customer experience

• Leadership responsibility for a dedicated three-person team, with opportunities to develop the team

• Close involvement in product development, supplier partnerships and emerging home furnishing trends

• A cross-functional working environment where creative ideas are balanced with customer needs and commercial objectives

• A results-oriented culture built on trust, teamwork and freedom with responsibility

• A straightforward working environment where ideas can quickly become action

• Opportunities for professional and personal development, along with attractive employee benefits

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As Head of Range and Design, you will own and develop JYSK’s overall design direction and collection architecture across product categories. You will ensure that our Scandinavian design DNA is reflected consistently in our collections, with colours, materials, shapes, functionality, quality and packaging working together to create a recognisable customer experience. Balancing creative ambition with customer insights and commercial priorities, you will turn the design vision into compelling, commercially successful products.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Developing collection architecture and design briefs in close collaboration with Category Management and suppliers

• Using customer insights, sales data and profitability to guide design decisions and strengthen range performance

• Presenting design concepts and recommendations to stakeholders, aligning creative ideas with commercial priorities

• Collaborating with Marketing, E-Commerce, Visual Merchandising and Sales & Expansion on photography, social media, campaigns and the overall customer experience

Besides the above, you will lead and develop the three-person Design team, setting clear priorities, providing constructive feedback and fostering a culture of creative excellence, collaboration and commercial awareness. You will participate in range meetings, trade fairs and supplier visits in Denmark and abroad, travelling approximately 30–40 days per year to stay up to date with emerging trends and bring new inspiration into JYSK.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a colleague who combines a strong design vision with commercial understanding and the ability to translate creative ideas into successful products across a broad product range.

Ideally, you bring:

• Solid experience in design, product development, range management or category management within an international retail, brand or lifestyle business, with a strong track record of developing product concepts or collections

• The ability to define a clear design direction and translate it into practical design briefs and priorities

• A strong understanding of Scandinavian design, including colours, materials, functionality and visual consistency

• A data-driven approach to decision-making, using customer insights, sales data and profitability to guide design choices

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build relationships and create alignment across functions

• Experience in leading and developing colleagues, setting clear priorities and fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous development

• Fluency in English and confidence in presenting design concepts and recommendations to different stakeholders

jobs.occupation: Data Portfolio Analyst for Markets Data Office
jobs.description:
Bring your banking and data experience into our newly established Markets Data Office. Join us and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now. Join us in building a new data capability in Markets

About the job

At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets.

We are a newly established team and still in our build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve.

As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets.

This is an opportunity to join early, influence how we work and make a real impact on how data is governed at scale.

What you will do

As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will take ownership of data governance activities within one of our four domain areas. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams to improve how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled.

Depending on your domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market data, price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data.

You will be part of one Markets Data Office with shared standards, tooling and governance practices, while also helping to define and improve these as the team develops.

Your responsibilities will include

• Taking ownership of ongoing data governance activities within your domain and driving them forward

• Identifying and documenting Critical Data Attributes (CDAs) by reviewing data attributes with stakeholders, assessing which are critical for Saxo and driving the governance of Critical Data Elements (CDEs)

• Analysing data together with data owners to assess quality, identify issues and lead root cause investigations

• Defining and maintaining data definitions, rules, thresholds and documentation used in monitoring and control activities

• Monitoring data quality outputs, tracking remediation and escalating when issues are not being resolved

• Building strong working relationships with data owners, data stewards and stakeholders across business and technology

• Helping shape the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office

A key part of your role will be making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain, helping create transparency and consistency across the organisation.

Who you are

You bring:

• Some years of experience from the banking sector, which is a requirement for this position

• Experience in data analysis, data quality, data governance or a related field

• The ability to understand data in the context of business processes and explain your findings clearly to both business and technical audiences

• The ability to produce clear and structured documentation

• Hands on experience with SQL. Experience with Python is an advantage

• Experience using AI and other technology tools to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working

It would be a clear advantage if you have

• Experience from Markets functions such as trading, market or counterparty risk, investment products or operations, including an understanding of how a trade moves from front to back

• Experience with data governance in financial services, for example CDEs, data ownership, data profiling, data controls, data lineage or BCBS 239

• Experience with Databricks, Great Expectations, OpenMetadata or similar data platforms and data quality tools

We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership. You move your work forward, follow through and take initiative.

• Collaborates naturally. You build trust with business stakeholders, technology teams and colleagues across different domain areas.

• Uses technology naturally. You use technology to analyse, automate, document and find more effective ways of working.

• Is comfortable working in an evolving environment. You can manage changing priorities, bring structure to areas that are still developing and help shape solutions as the team grows.

• Is structured and curious. You have a strong analytical mindset, pay attention to detail and enjoy understanding how things work.

What we offer

• The opportunity to help build a new data function and its foundations from the ground up

• Real ownership and influence on how critical data is governed across Markets

• Exposure to key business domains and critical data flows

• The opportunity to work closely with experienced colleagues across Markets, data and technology

• A role that can develop alongside a growing team

You will join the Markets Data Office at an early stage of its journey, giving you the opportunity to take on new challenges, grow your responsibility and influence how critical data is managed across Markets.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

Furthermore, you are open to new ways of working, including AI-powered tools, and look for opportunities to automate repetitive tasks, improve quality, and focus on higher-value work.

We look forward to receiving your application.

Curious about how technology and AI can improve the way we work with data? Join Saxo and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now. Join us in building a new data capability in Markets

About the job

At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets.

We are a newly established team and still very much in the build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve.

As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets.

This is an opportunity to join early, learn quickly and have a real influence on how we work.

What you will do

Technology will be an important part of your role. Together with colleagues in the team, you will help strengthen our technical foundation. This could mean building AI supported workflows, contributing to Azure projects, automating manual processes or exploring new tools and platforms.

As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will work across our four domain areas together with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams. Your focus will be on improving how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled. Depending on the domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market and price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data.

You will learn about Markets from experienced colleagues and gradually take ownership of your own areas and tasks. You will be part of one Markets Data Office, working with shared standards, tooling and governance practices. You will sit close to the business and help turn business needs into practical technical solutions. We want you to experiment, test ideas and find better ways of working.

Your responsibilities will include

• Exploring and testing new technology, including AI, and helping the team choose and use the right tools

• Setting up reporting and dashboards for data owners and data stewards, for example in Power BI

• Automating manual parts of our governance work, including data quality checks, documentation and metadata

• Building and maintaining AI supported workflows and data workflows together with colleagues and technology teams, for example in Azure or Databricks

• Testing and validating automated workflows, including AI outputs, before they are used in day to day governance work

• Helping define and maintain data definitions, rules, thresholds and supporting documentation

• Monitoring data quality outputs, following up on remediation and raising issues when they are not being resolved

• Working with data owners, stewards and stakeholders across business and technology, and helping translate between business needs and technical solutions

• Contributing to the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office

A key part of the role is making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain. This helps create transparency and consistency across the organisation.

Who you are

You have recently completed a master’s degree or have around one to two years of professional experience.

• A relevant degree in areas such as information systems, data science, computer science, business analytics or a similar field

• An interest in data and how it supports business processes, combined with an interest in connecting business and technology

• Experience with SQL, Python or similar tools from your studies, a student job or personal projects

• Hands on experience using AI or other technology to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working

• Good communication skills in English and the ability to write clear and structured documentation

You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters most is that you are curious, willing to learn and motivated to build your technical skills.

An advantage if you have

• Familiarity with Azure, Databricks, Power BI, Great Expectations, data catalogue tools such as OpenMetadata or similar technologies

• Experience building with AI beyond everyday use, for example agents, LiteLLM based workflows, prompt engineering or automation using tools such as Power Automate

• Experience from banking or financial services, for example through a student job

• Knowledge of, or an interest in, Markets functions such as trading, risk, investment products or operations, including how a trade moves from front to back

• Exposure to data governance or data quality work such as data profiling, data controls or data lineage, ideally within financial services

We are looking for someone who:

• Collaborates naturally. You build relationships with business stakeholders, technology teams and colleagues across different domain areas

• Uses technology naturally. You enjoy experimenting with new tools, testing ideas and learning from things that do not work the first time

jobs.occupation: Senior Financial Controller, Group Accounting & Controlling
jobs.description:
Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions is looking for a Senior Financial Controller to join our office in Copenhagen.

Team

You will be a part of a team consisting of five skilled financial professionals and will support our financial strategy to align with CIP FS’ ambitious long-term goals.

You will engage senior stakeholders to provide crucial financial insights across our platform companies and regions.

Role

Reporting to the VP of Global Controlling and Financial Reporting, you will contribute to the consolidation of the group’s financial statements and related reporting processes. You will be responsible for ensuring high-quality financial reporting and compliance with relevant accounting standards, and for supporting the business with accurate and timely insights.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Monthly controlling of accounts including cost controlling, balance sheet controlling and intercompany (IC) controlling

• Prepare and analyze consolidated financial statements and management reports

• Driving improvements in reporting processes and financial controls

• Collaborate with finance teams across the organization to ensure best practices in group reporting

• Close cooperation with the global capability center (shared service center)

• Oversight and controlling of service provider activities and point of contact for local service providers responsible for finance and corporate matters

• Act as a contact for auditors and internal stakeholders

You

You have an MSc in Economics or Finance and 3-5 years of full-time experience in audit, financial controlling, or consultancy from a Big4 firm. You also have experience in consolidation and are motivated by building best practices, solving complex issues and developing the finance function.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• Comprehensive knowledge of cost accounting and controlling

• Advanced analytical skills and attention to detail

• Effective time management, with the ability to prioritize assignments and manage short deadlines

• Solid communication skills and ability to collaborate across functions

• Curious and self-driven

• Danish GAAP and consolidation principles knowledge

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written

• Experience with Business Central and OneStream is an advantage

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

Student Assistant - Business Development and E-commerce

Are you analytically strong, curious about digital business and motivated by turning data into useful commercial insights?

Join us in a shared student role where you will support both our e-commerce activities and international business development work.

The role

You will work across two teams with data as the common thread. You will support recurring analyses and reporting, help create transparency from complex datasets, and contribute to material used for commercial decisions.

Your key tasks

• Collect, structure, validate, and analyse e-commerce, market, competitor, and other commercial data.

• Maintain recurring reports and performance overviews, and identify trends, gaps and potential business opportunities

• Turn complex data into clear insights, visualisations and presentations for commercial stakeholders and management

• Support e-commerce and business development projects by preparing analyses, consolidating input, and improving data-driven ways of working

What we are looking for

• You are studying at your last year at the bachelor's degree or at the master's level

• You are comfortable working with data and have solid Excel and Power BI skills. Experienced user of PowerPoint and AI tools is an advantage

• You work in a structured and detail-oriented way and can communicate findings clearly

• You are curious, proactive, and comfortable collaborating with stakeholders across teams and countries.

• You communicate confidently in English

What we offer

• A varied student role combining e-commerce and international business development tasks

• Hands-on experience with commercial analysis, management presentations and data-driven decision support

• Growing responsibility for recurring tasks, with guidance and sparring from experienced colleagues

• Flexible working hours that can be adapted to your studies. (Expect to be in office in Bjerringbro bi-weekly)

Why Grundfos

At Grundfos, we dare to do things that others cannot or dare not do. Our skills commit us to pioneer solutions to the world’s water and climate challenges and improve the quality of life for people. Joining us as a student assistant, you too can drive this change while improving both your skills and resume. You become part of a close-knitted team in an inspiring, learning environment with access to great learning resources.

Practical information

Location:                    Remote and in Bjerringbro

Working hours:          10-15 hours/week

Start date:                  As soon as possible

Application deadline: We will close this job posting when we have found the right candidate, so we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible

Additional information

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact Senior Business Development Manager, Henriette Drægert Grønning at +4540333919

Please send your resume and cover letter today by clicking on the link “Apply for this job”.
